title: KRX Quant Engine API v1
description: The bodies of every /v1 endpoint, one definition each (docs/engine-api.md). A field not named here breaks the contract.

commit.description: The commit the engine runs (the deploy's KRX_COMMIT), or unknown

cpu.description: The CPU budget: expected algorithm seconds per bar close against it.

usd_futures.description: The USD futures' latest trade today against the previous close read at 07:30; null before today's first trade.

training.description: The latest night's training as the 08:00 swap saw it. #355: on a server that trains, also before any night's list was stored: day and finalized_at null, promoted and reports empty, applied false.

last_applied.description: #355: the last night whose promotion list the morning swap applied (state/models/applied.json); null before any.

nights_not_applied.description: #355: the trading nights since last_applied whose list does not run: their training failed, or their morning swap passed without it.

failures.description: #355: of those nights, the ones whose training failed here, as kept in state/training/nights.json.

loki.description: Live only (#358): the collector's log lines' copy in Grafana Cloud Loki. Off: enabled false, the reason, the counts 0 and the times null.

reason.description: Why nothing is sent; null while it sends

last_error.description: The last failure's kind: HTTP 503, URLError(TimeoutError); never its text

kis.description: Live and demo (made up) only: the KIS connection and each feed's latest delivery.

name.description: The company's name (#250); null until read, or when no source names it.

logo_url.description: The company's square logo as Toss Securities shows it (#250); a code without one answers 403.

prediction_item.description: A prediction of the stream, where several symbols go together.

prediction_fields.description: The fields of a prediction, open so the stream's items can add the symbol.

target_at.description: null unless the status is ok: only those are scored.

blocked.description: Why a final consensus is not to be acted on (#88); null for any other prediction.

pooled.description: The active algorithms a consensus pooled, in registration order (#107); null for any other prediction, an empty consensus, and those made before.

votes.description: A consensus's members by the class each forecast most likely (#106); null for any other prediction, an empty consensus, and those made before.

class_a.description: For one release (#170): the bar close's touch label, as touch.class (no longer basis A's class, which stays in the DB).

class_b.description: For one release (#170): the touch label too, as class_a.

unscorable.description: Why the touch label is missing (#170): touch.unscorable, or 'no touch label' where the bar close has none; null when it is there.

touch.description: A bar close's touch label (#160, #167): what the outcome is scored on (#170).

target_version.description: The touch label's version (touch.TARGET_VERSION): 3, crossed quotes counted (#187). Only the engine's current version is served; 2 (crossed quotes dropped) stays in the DB only.

bars.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/bars: today's finished bars, or with before/limit the last bars before a time across days (#108). A stored (backfilled) bar has trades null.

candles.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/candles?period=day|week|month|year: the stored candles before a time, oldest first, each dated by its period's first day (a week's Monday, a month's 1st, a year's 1 January), never the one holding today (#111, #112). Prices are adjusted. venue is where they come from (UN integrated KRX + NXT, KRX regular session), null with none stored.

supply.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/supply?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD: the symbol's daily supply data kept (#226) on the days from to to (KST dates, both included; default the year to today, at most 4000 days), oldest first, a day the sources have nothing of left out. Counts are shares, foreign_ratio a percentage of the listed shares; a value the sources lack that day is null.

supply_day.description: A day's supply data (#226): the short-sale volume, the net buys of individuals, institutions and foreigners (negative: net sold), the foreign holdings and their ratio to the listed shares (%), the stock lending balance and the credit (margin loan) balance.

special.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/special?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD: the special situations' windows the engine kept (#236) that start on the days from to to (KST dates, both included; default the last five trading days to today, at most 60 days): the symbol's VIs and the whole market's circuit breakers and sidecars, by start.

special_window.description: A special situation's window (#12, #236). end is the release; a VI whose release is not known yet lasts start + 3 minutes, and a third breaker stage to the end of the day. detail is a breaker's stage, a VI's type when known (static, dynamic, both), else null.

algorithm_detail.description: GET /v1/algorithms/{name}: the item, with the models installed on the server for it, oldest first.

algorithm_fields.description: The fields of an algorithm, open so the detail can add to them.

kind.description: The kind it predicts (#179): direction, or another of GET /v1/kinds.

card.description: An algorithm's card always names its scientist.

feature_meanings.description: Each of its features (every name in features): what it is, its unit, when it is known.

param_meanings.description: Every parameter its model can hold (default or fitted; a superset of model.params' names).

target_version.description: The target its labels were of (#170): 3 the touch target counting crossed quotes (#187), 2 the touch target dropping them (before #187), 1 the four-minute move; a kind's algorithm, its kind's answer version. null for the defaults and for a model saved before it was recorded (the four-minute move's). Only models of the engine's target version (a kind's: its answer version) count toward the statuses and the consensus weights.

model_training.description: What the model was trained on, as values (#165): trained's text. null for the defaults and for a model saved before #165.

loss.description: mean log loss on its own training samples: not comparable with a validation loss

days.description: The days trained on by where their labels came from: recorded (mid-points) and bars (one-minute closes). null when the samples did not say.

night_validation.description: The algorithm's report of the latest night's training (#165), as stored (reports/<day>/<algorithm>.json). null without a night, or without a report for it.

samples.description: validation samples; null where it did not get to validate

challenger.description: The new model; null when it was not trained.

champion.description: The model the server ran; null when there was nothing to validate on.

stage.description: Where an algorithm on probation or on the bench stands toward its next review (#165), as of the latest review. null in any other status.

counted_from.description: The first day counted; on probation, the first day it predicted with a model trained on the touch target (#170). null while it waits for one: nothing is counted yet.

days.description: trading days counted through the latest review

next_review.description: the next review day, as the day counted; null past the last

next_review_on.description: The day it falls on if the engine predicts every trading day.

weakest.description: The weakest lift by trading day over lift_days, at level; null unless every baseline has one (two days or more).

enough.description: enough scored predictions and pairs over lift_days (min_sample) for the review to decide

simulated.description: Of days, those simulated (#298): a simulated probation's first days, counted ahead of the live days after them. 0 on the bench and without a simulation.

Its review counted simulated days (#298): a simulated probation's review at once (its reason starts with "simulated probation"), or a later review counting them (its reason ends with "of the days simulated"). False otherwise, and for every change made before #298.

simulation.description: An algorithm's latest simulated probation (#298): the latest trading days replayed as if it had been on probation, kept apart from the live predictions (the leaderboard and the statistics never count them), and the review it made at once. null when none of its probations was simulated.

probation_began.description: When the probation it was made for began: its status change's at.

cadence.description: daily: refitted before each day on the days before it; bar_close: trained once before the days. null when it could not be simulated.

days.description: the days replayed; 0 when it could not be simulated

training.description: How it was trained: cadence, then a daily kind's model of each day (models, by day) or a bar-close kind's one model (model, target_version, first_day, last_day, samples, days by where their labels came from: recorded, bars). null when it could not be simulated.

review.description: The review it made at once; null when it could not be simulated.

review_day.description: the largest review day its days reach; null below the first

weakest.description: its weakest lift by trading day over the days, at the review's level

reason.description: its status change's reason; null when it made none

why.description: why it could not be simulated; null when it was

baselines.description: The baselines' cards: three, four with the touch target (KRX_TARGET_VERSION=3, the default; #169: baseline-climate).

consensus.description: The two consensus predictions' cards; their members and weights now are GET /v1/consensus.

card.description: A predictor's card (#164): written for the target now, the mid-point's change four minutes on.

scientist.description: null: a baseline, named after no one

forecasting.description: how the three probabilities are made

failure.description: the market it tends to be wrong in

meaning.description: What a feature or a model parameter is (#164).

known.description: when it is known: at the bar close, before the open, learned overnight

entry.description: One algorithm's stats over a query.

entry_fields.description: The fields of an entry, open so others can add to them (entry, ranked_entry, the stats' overall).

pnl.description: The touch P&L in ticks (#170, research only), a down call as a short of the stock: less the sell tax and both commissions.

pnl_inverse.description: The touch P&L in ticks (#267, research only), a down call through the symbol's single-stock inverse product: less both commissions only (an ETF pays no sell tax), on the product's notional (half the stock's for a −2x product). A down call on a symbol without one, or before it was listed, is no trade.

lift.description: An entry's lifts over each baseline (its kind's, #179), absent for a baseline and when no baseline was scored.

day_low.description: The weakest lift's lower bound by trading day: what the statuses are decided by.

by_day.description: The lift taken a trading day at a time (each day's mean gain one value); null from fewer than two days.

ranked_entry.description: A leaderboard entry of an algorithm, with its status now and what its stats leave out.

baseline_entry.description: A leaderboard entry of a baseline, with what its stats leave out.

excluded.description: What a query's stats leave out of a predictor's predictions (#83): scored ones touched by a special situation (left out unless special=include, then counted in), those its basis could not score, and those not made, by status.

calibration.description: Ten bins of forecast probabilities by tenths, against how often the class happened.

query.description: The query a leaderboard or stats answer was computed for, open so they can add to it.

basis.description: Gone with #170 (every prediction is scored on its touch label): for one release the basis a screen from before sent, echoed back as sent; absent when none was sent.

leaderboard.description: GET /v1/leaderboard: the direction's (without kind, or kind=direction: as before #179), or another kind's (kind_leaderboard).

algorithm_stats.description: GET /v1/algorithms/{name}/stats: of the predictor's kind (#179), the direction's or another's (kind_algorithm_stats).

by_volatility.description: The calls split into volatility terciles by the barrier width w at their bar close (basis points), per symbol by sorted order (ties by bar close); a tercile without calls is left out.

volatility_cuts.description: Each symbol's two cuts of w in basis points of the mid-point: the widest w in low and in mid.

skill.description: Skill against the class rates (#262), from the calls' table of called × happened classes; null without a scored prediction.

expected_accuracy.description: What calls independent of the outcome, at the same class rates, get right.

independence.description: Pearson's chi-square on the table (Pesaran–Timmermann 2009 for independent observations); the overlapping windows make p too small: it describes. chi2 and p are null when a used cell expects fewer than 5.

by_day.description: Cohen's kappa taken a trading day at a time: each day's kappa one value, the days' mean with a Student t 95% interval and the one-sided p of no skill (#262). n is the days with a kappa; null from fewer than two.

kinds.description: GET /v1/kinds (#179): every kind of prediction the engine makes, the direction first.

prediction_kind.description: A kind of prediction (#179): its three classes in order (a forecast's class is the most likely, a tie the middle one, then the first), the classes precision and coverage count, the fields of its output besides the probabilities, its answer version and its baselines' cards. A daily kind (#264) is predicted once a trading day: its horizon_minutes is null and daily says when.

horizon_minutes.description: How long its windows run from the bar close (#263): 4, the touch target's, or a longer kind's; null for a daily kind (#264), which has no bar close.

daily.description: A daily kind's day (#264): when it is predicted (KST, each trading day), the auctions its window runs between and over how many sessions (#310: 1, the day; 5, the day to the close of its fifth session), when its answers are first looked for on the window's last session (once its closing auction price is kept; a window of several sessions also waits for that day's KRX day candle), and the days with an answer its statuses are judged on; null for a kind predicted at each bar close.

awaiting.description: Why the kind is not run yet (#310): what a probe has not settled of the data its answers read; it is listed, but not predicted, answered, trained or pre-validated. null for a kind that runs.

review_hold.description: Why the kind's algorithms are held out of probation (#310: an overlapping kind's review days are fixed from the variance ratio its first pre-validation measures, and until then one that passed is not run); null when they are not.

kind_prediction_item.description: A prediction of a kind in the stream, where several symbols go together.

kind_prediction_fields.description: The fields of a prediction of a kind besides the direction (#179), open so the stream's items can add the symbol.

bar_close.description: The bar close; a daily kind's (#264): its prediction time, 08:50 of the day.

target_at.description: null unless the status is ok: only those are scored. A daily kind's (#264): its day's close (the closing auction's end).

flat_ticks.description: k at the bar close (#200): the flat band in ticks at its mid-point, what the kind's predictors were given and the range's answer counts; kept as the price moves on. Every status has it. null without a mid-point at the bar close, and for predictions stored before #200.

width_ticks.description: The barrier width w at the bar close (#183), in ticks of its mid-point, for a kind with barriers (the barrier's): fixed there by the engine, what its answer is made with, the same for every predictor of the bar close; never below k. Every status has it. null for a kind without barriers (the range), without a mid-point at the bar close, and for predictions stored before #183.

anchor.description: The integrated mid-point at the bar close (#210), the reference the kind's answer is measured from (its path's anchor), so a barrier's U and L, anchor ± width_ticks × tick, are known before its answer is in. Kept as the price moves on; every status has it. null without a mid-point at the bar close, and for predictions stored before #210.

tick.description: The tick size at anchor (#210), in won: its path's tick. null without a mid-point at the bar close, and for predictions stored before #210.

band.description: A daily kind's flat band of the day (#264): |close / open − 1| at most it is flat, set from the days before it and known at the prediction time (its answer's path band). null for a kind predicted at each bar close, and without days enough to set it.

output.description: p_<class> for each of the kind's three classes (GET /v1/kinds), a distribution, then the kind's fields; null unless the status is ok. The range's: range_output (#180); the barrier's: barrier_output (#183); open_to_close's and open_to_close_5d's (#310): open_to_close_output (#264).

answer.description: Its bar close's answer, every predictor's of the kind there; null before its four minutes are over, and unless the status is ok.

kind_answer_item.description: An answer of a kind in the stream, of one symbol and bar close.

kind_answer_fields.description: A bar close's answer of a kind (#179), open so the stream's items can add the symbol and the bar close: its class (null when its window could not be scored, unscorable says why), whether a VI, circuit breaker or sidecar touched its window, and the kind's summary of the window.

path.description: The kind's summary of the window. The range's: range_path (#180); the barrier's: barrier_path (#183); open_to_close's: open_to_close_path (#264); open_to_close_5d's: open_to_close_5d_path (#310).

range_output.description: A range prediction's output (#180, kind range): the three classes' probabilities (a distribution) and the quantiles of r, the four minutes' integrated mid-point range in ticks, 0 <= q10 <= q50 <= q90.

range_path.description: A range answer's path (#180): empty for a window not followed (restarted, not recorded); else r (ticks, half-tick steps; null without a mid-point at the bar close), k, the tick, the reference mid-point, the highest and lowest mid-points of the window and when each was first received (the bar close for the reference), how far the mid-point went up and down (ticks), the quotes received, whether they went silent for 60 s, and the highest bid and lowest ask.

range_stats.description: A range predictor's own statistics (#180, a kind entry's extra): of its n scored predictions, each quantile's pinball loss, the share of r within q10-q90 (ideally 0.8, Wilson 95%), the mean absolute error of q50 (ticks), and the pinball loss less range-climate's on the same bar closes (null for range-climate itself; descriptive, never judged on).

range_quantile_means.description: A mean for each quantile of a range output (#180).

range_mean.description: A mean with its normal 95% interval, and taken by trading day (each day's mean one value, Student t 95%, n the days; null from fewer than two).

barrier_output.description: A barrier prediction's output (#183, kind barrier): the three classes' probabilities (a distribution), up first, timeout, down first; no other field (the width is the prediction's width_ticks).

barrier_path.description: A barrier answer's path (#183): empty for a window not followed (restarted, not recorded); else the width w and the four-minute volatility sigma it came from (ticks; null when too few bars set w = k), k, the tick, the reference mid-point, the barriers U and L, the round-trip cost (ticks), the best quote at the bar close, when each barrier was first reached (by received time) and the best quote then, the last best quote received in the window, the quotes received and whether they went silent for 60 s. Since answer version 2 (#187) the window's quotes include crossed ones (best ask below best bid): a barrier's quote, the last one and the count may be crossed. Without a mid-point at the bar close the barriers and the width are null.

barrier_stats.description: A barrier predictor's own statistics (#183, a kind entry's extra): of its n scored predictions, the barrier P&L (research only) of its calls: a long on up_first, a short on down_first, none on timeout, all of them (pnl) and each side (long, short).

pnl_inverse.description: As pnl, the shorts through the symbol's single-stock inverse product (#267): no sell tax; a short on a symbol without one, or before it was listed, is no trade.

short_inverse.description: The shorts alone, through the inverse product (#267).

barrier_pnl.description: Barrier trades' P&L in ticks less the round-trip cost (#183, research only): how many, their total and the mean per trade with its normal 95% interval.

open_to_close_output.description: An open_to_close prediction's output (#264): the three classes' probabilities (a distribution), up, flat, down; no other field (the day's band is the prediction's band).

open_to_close_path.description: An open_to_close answer's path (#264): empty for a day whose prices never came (answer version 2: no closing auction; version 1: no candle); else the KRX opening and closing auctions' prices (won, adjusted as the KRX day candle is), the change close / open − 1, the band it is classed by and the volatility and scale it came from (null without days enough to set it: no band), the fee rate (the P&L's costs), where the close came from (version 2: KRX's one-minute bar of the closing auction, else the recorded print, or the KRX day candle on a day before the after-market without either; version 1: the KRX day candle), and the day's VIs of the symbol.

open_to_close_5d_path.description: An open_to_close_5d answer's path (#310): empty for a window whose end day's candle never came (no candle); else the first session's opening auction price and the fifth's closing auction price (won, adjusted as the KRX day candles of one fetch are), the change close / open − 1, the band it is classed by with the volatility and scale it came from (null without ended windows enough: no band), the fee rate, where the close came from, the window's last session as KRX held it, its sessions (5), the five sessions' closes (null for one the symbol has none of) and the previous session's close (the inverse product's daily reset), whether a cash dividend's ex-date falls after the first session (#310: KIS's adjusted prices do not take dividends out; true if one of sessions two to five is marked ex-dividend by KIS's 락 구분, 02 or 05, false if all four are marked 00, null otherwise: a session the symbol has none of, a candle without the mark, a mark not measured), and the five sessions' VIs of the symbol.

open_to_close_5d_stats.description: An open_to_close_5d predictor's own statistics (#310, a kind entry's extra): open_to_close_stats's fields over the five sessions, the per-trade intervals Driscoll–Kraay ones (the windows of neighbouring days overlap); the inverse product's P&L is its five sessions' daily reset −2x, on the stock's notional.

open_to_close_stats.description: An open_to_close predictor's own statistics (#264, a kind entry's extra): of its n scored predictions, the P&L (research only) of following its calls from the opening auction to the closing auction: a long on up, a short of the stock on down, none on flat (pnl, long, short), and the downs through the symbol's single-stock inverse product (pnl_inverse, short_inverse; none for a symbol without one or a day before its listing).

open_to_close_pnl.description: open_to_close trades' P&L in basis points of the open less the round-trip cost (#264, research only): how many, their total and the mean per trade with its 95% interval: normal for open_to_close, Driscoll–Kraay for open_to_close_5d (#310: the windows of neighbouring days overlap).

kind_latest.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/kinds/{kind}/latest (#179): the kind's predictions of the symbol's latest bar close.

kind_entry.description: One predictor's stats of a kind over a query (#179).

kind_entry_fields.description: The fields of a kind's entry (#179), open so others can add to them: the direction's without the touch P&L, the kind's own statistics, and its windows' overlap (#310).

precision.description: Of the calls of the kind's action classes, the share that happened.

coverage.description: The share of calls of the kind's action classes.

extra.description: The kind's own statistics; null for a kind without. The range's: range_stats (#180); the barrier's: barrier_stats (#183); open_to_close's: open_to_close_stats (#264); open_to_close_5d's: open_to_close_5d_stats (#310).

overlap_sessions.description: How many trading sessions the kind's windows run (#310): 1 for every kind but a daily kind of several sessions, whose neighbouring days' windows share sessions; then its accuracy, precision, coverage, Brier score, lifts and P&L intervals are Driscoll–Kraay ones and its lifts by trading day Newey–West ones (its calibration bins are not corrected).

independent_days.description: About how many independent windows the entry's trading days hold (#310): the days with a scored prediction ÷ overlap_sessions, rounded down.

kind_ranked_entry.description: A kind's leaderboard entry of an algorithm, with its status now and what its stats leave out.

kind_baseline_entry.description: A kind's leaderboard entry of a baseline, with what its stats leave out.

kind_leaderboard.description: GET /v1/leaderboard?kind=<a kind besides the direction> (#179): its algorithms ranked against its baselines.

kind_algorithm_stats.description: GET /v1/algorithms/{name}/stats of a predictor of a kind besides the direction (#179).

macro.description: GET /v1/macro: the latest day's regime and readings; nulls before any.

calendar.description: GET /v1/calendar: the economic calendar from the start of today (KST), in time order, as last read; fetched_at null before any read.

briefing.description: GET /v1/briefing?day=YYYY-MM-DD (#304): the pre-open briefing of a day (default: today, or the next trading day on a closed day). Every part is there, with nulls (or recorded false) where its data is not.

flow.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/flow?day=YYYY-MM-DD (#306): a symbol's intraday flows of a day from the recorded feeds (program trading, member firms, investor estimates), a minute at a time over the regular session; values as KIS gives them, cumulative over the day; a minute without a record is null.

flow_member.description: A member firm among the day's top five sellers or buyers of a symbol (#306).

flow_totals_fields.description: Each flow's day total as last recorded by a time (#306); a fragment the flow answer's totals extend.

closing_flow.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/closing-flow (#305): the day's closing rebalancing demand of the symbol's single-stock ±2x ETFs, A × (L² − L) × r, in won (+ buy, − sell): at the minute (the reference price just before it, over the previous trading day's KRX close) in continuous trading, the 15:20 one from the closing auction on; by structure (spot_futures, futures) and in all; ratio is spot_futures over the median recorded closing auction value of the 20 trading days before (an upper bound; null, with denominator_reason, without one), ratio_total the total's; a product without its net assets is in missing and out of the sums. The day is today if it trades, else the last trading day. A null demand comes with its reason.

closing_flow_product.description: A single-stock ETF's row (#305): its leverage L, structure, L² − L, net assets on the previous trading day (won; null: not kept), their day and source, and its demand (won).

closing_flow_days.description: GET /v1/symbols/{symbol}/closing-flow/days?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (#305): the closing flow's days kept (computed once a day after the 20:30 backfill; computed_at null before the first) from from to to (KST dates, both included; default the year to today, at most 4000 days), oldest first, and their summary by period and by tertile of the ratio's size, each with the special situations' days in and out.

closing_flow_day.description: A day of the closing flow (#305): its 15:20 demand (won; live: stored at 15:20, bars: from its net assets and the bars' flow; null without either) and ratios as the answer's, the median closing auction value of the 20 trading days before and how many had one, its own closing auction value from the recorded KRX trades (null without the print recorded; the one-minute bar's fallback waits for check-closing-flow-305), the closing auction's move, the day's flow to it and the next day's gap and close-to-close in bp (#270's definitions), whether the auction went the demand's way (the flow's on a day without one; null if either did not move), and the special situations begun that day.

closing_flow_stats.description: A summary cell of the closing flow's days (#305), as structure-check section 2 counts (#270): the days, the median |closing auction move| in bp, how often the auction went the demand's (else the flow's) way and how often the next day's gap and close went against it, each of the days where both moved, with that count.

cost_map.description: GET /v1/cost-map?symbol=&period=&special= (#307): each symbol's round-trip costs, a row each kind with a direction (its sides) with the breakeven hit rate beside the hit rates of its final consensus, first-ranked algorithm and strongest baseline (the leaderboard's statistics for the same query), and the period base rates kept (null before they are computed, with why).

cost_symbol.description: A symbol's cost card (#307): its reference price (the mid-point now in continuous trading, live; else the latest bar close's, with that bar close), and its costs there (null without a price).

tick_edge.description: A tick-band edge near the price (#307): the edge, the first price past it, and the tick and k there.

cost_row.description: A kind with a direction on the cost map (#307): its width W and cost C (limit and market orders) at the bar close whose C/W is the median, ticks (a daily kind's median band and its cost, basis points), the breakeven C/W and p* = (W + C) / 2W for a symmetric answer (null with why for the others), and its three predictors (null for none).

cost_predictor.description: A predictor on a cost-map row (#307): its hit rate of rise and fall calls (the leaderboard's precision), the edge (the share right less the share wrong the other way), its calls, its research P&L per trade in the row's unit (null for a kind without one), and its verdict against each cost's p* (pass, fail, few calls; null without p*).

base_rates.description: The period base rates kept (#307, state/base_rates.json): the four-minute touch labels by the one-minute bar rule, a row a symbol and period (structure-check's section 3).

event.description: A message of GET /v1/stream (WebSocket), one JSON text each.

prediction_event.description: Predictions just displayed for a bar close: the baselines, or an algorithm.

consensus_event.description: A consensus just displayed for a bar close.

outcome_event.description: Predictions just scored, with their outcomes.

health_event.description: The KIS status, on connecting and when the connection or a feed's gap changes. Live and demo only.

bar_event.description: The one-minute bar being made (#110): its values so far, sent for each symbol at most once a poll (1 s), when they changed.

kind_prediction_event.description: Predictions of a kind besides the direction just displayed for a bar close (#179): its baselines, or an algorithm. The kind is prediction_kind (a consensus event's kind is fast or final). A client that does not know the type ignores it.

kind_answer_event.description: A kind's answers just made, four minutes after their bar closes (#179): what its predictions there are scored on.
